name: Scroll Network token unchecked router transfer underflow
summary: The unverified SCROLL token exempted whitelisted senders, including Uniswap's Universal Router set in its constructor, from the balance check on transfers. Since anyone can make the router run its TRANSFER command, the attacker had the zero-balance router send SCROLL it never held into the SCROLL/WETH pair and swapped it for the pair's WETH; copycats repeated it on later refills.
notes: The router's whitelist entry (mapping slot 3) is already set at the deployment block; the deployer's later 7f21b9b9 calls for the router and V2 router wrote nothing, so deployment is the reset.

Campaign: four later transactions by two other senders minted SCROLL through the router into the pair and swapped out WETH that had been added after the anchor. Router sweeps to EOAs that removed no WETH, and the deployer's own liquidity removals and sells, are not exploits.
